name: The Three Colliding Universes Overview
description: Avengers: Doomsday centers on a catastrophic multiversal convergence where three distinct realities—Earth-616 (the main MCU), Earth-828 (the retro-futuristic 1960s world of The Fantastic Four: First Steps), and Earth-10005 (the Fox X-Men timeline)—collide via simultaneous Incursions, forcing heroes across realities to unite or clash before Doctor Doom reshapes the remnants into Battleworld.

name: Earth-616 (The Main MCU Reality)
description: The primary MCU universe destabilized by the Time Heist, Doctor Strange's multiversal spells, Wanda Maximoff's Darkhold dreamwalking, and Dar-Benn's Quantum Band space-time tear. Houses Sam Wilson's official Avengers, the Watchtower-based New Avengers (Thunderbolts*), and the Wakanda-Talokan alliance.

name: Earth-828 (The Fantastic Four's Retro-Futuristic Reality)
description: A 1960s-inspired retro-futuristic universe home to Reed Richards, Sue Storm, Johnny Storm, Ben Grimm, and their reality-warping son Franklin Richards. After Doctor Doom approaches young Franklin in the Baxter Building, the Fantastic Four cross into Earth-616 aboard their interdimensional Excelsior spacecraft.

name: Earth-10005 (The Fox X-Men Universe)
description: The mutant-populated universe previously saved from decay by Deadpool and Wolverine. Currently anchored to Earth-616 by Monica Rambeau's presence at the X-Mansion alongside Professor X, Magneto, Cyclops, Beast, Nightcrawler, Mystique, and Gambit, putting Earth-10005 on a direct collision course with Earth-616.

name: Incursions (The Collision Mechanism)
description: A multiversal phenomenon introduced in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness where the boundary between two universes erodes—often due to multiversal travel or timeline tampering—causing their Earths to smash together and destroy one or both realities unless one Earth is annihilated.

name: The TVA & The 3,000+ Incursion Cascade
description: Revealed in the Avengers: Endgame Encore post-credits scene, Ouroboros and Mobius witness over 3,000 simultaneous Incursions erupting across the multiverse, overwhelming God Loki's Yggdrasil timeline tree and triggering total multiversal collapse.

name: Battleworld (Marvel Comics Secret Wars Lore)
description: In Jonathan Hickman's 2015 Secret Wars comic storyline, when the multiverse dies in a final Incursion between Earth-616 and Earth-1610, Doctor Doom uses stolen cosmic and reality-warping power to salvage fragments of destroyed universes and stitch them together into a single patchwork planet called Battleworld.

name: God Emperor Doom & The Domains of Battleworld
description: On Battleworld, Victor von Doom rules as an omnipotent God Emperor from Castle Doom, wiping the memories of surviving heroes so they believe Battleworld has always existed, while dividing the planet into distinct feudal territories ('Domains') governed by Barons—such as the Deadlands (Marvel Zombies), Manhattan, the Shield, and Perfection.

name: How Doomsday Sets Up Battleworld for Avengers: Secret Wars (2027)
description: In the MCU, Doctor Doom targets reality-shaping power sources—Franklin Richards's Power Cosmic (Earth-828), Wanda Maximoff's Chaos Magic (resurrected in VisionQuest), Hulk's gamma energy (abducted in Endgame: Encore), and God Loki's throne at the End of Time—so that when Earth-616, Earth-828, and Earth-10005 inevitably collide at the climax of Doomsday, Doom can seize control and forge Battleworld for Avengers: Secret Wars.
